jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager
jobs.description: We are assisting our client, an early-stage consumer brand, in hiring a Growth Marketing Manager to lead growth across e-commerce, paid media and digital marketing. This is a hands-on role for someone who is equally comfortable analyzing performance data, identifying growth opportunities and turning business priorities into campaigns that drive measurable results. Working closely with the Founder, the Growth Marketing Manager will help shape and execute the client’s growth strategy across DTC, paid media, social, creator campaigns and key retail initiatives. The role will also lead and coordinate the Content Marketing Manager and Visual & Multimedia Designer, ensuring that strategy, content, creative and performance marketing work together toward clear commercial objectives. The ideal candidate is proactive, commercially minded and comfortable building processes and testing new approaches as the business grows. Proven experience in growth marketing, performance marketing, digital marketing or e-commerce, preferably within consumer, lifestyle, wellness, sports, food & beverage or direct-to-consumer (DTC) brands. Hands-on experience managing Meta Ads campaigns and advertising budgets. Strong working knowledge of Shopify or similar e-commerce platforms, GA4, Meta Ads Manager and other analytics tools. Ability to analyze data and understand how creative, paid media and conversion rates contribute to revenue, while considering brand identity and customer needs. Commercial awareness, with the ability to turn insights into actionable recommendations aligned with business priorities. Strong project management skills, with experience managing multiple campaigns and coordinating or leading creative, content or social media teams. Strong communication and collaboration skills, including confidence working directly with the Founder. A proactive, resourceful and accountable approach, with the flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and help build processes in an early-stage
